claim.scope: Finite 48-profile public writer/reader stock/library complete-part corpus; direct ordinary QBit at shared JSON path q, shared ADVANCED v2/CHUNKED v3 and String0/1.
claim.review_limitation: Luna candidate/static reviews are correlated. Root independently inspects source/diff, executes serial suites/builds/native jobs, reconstructs literal sentinels, authenticates captures and executes semantic mutation checks.

implementation.change: Replace two paired blanket QBit bulk-child refusals with direct-QBit-only admission; keep QBit-containing wrappers and borrowed/JSON/aggregate guards.
implementation.recursive_contract: Reuse leaf scalar/bulk codecs and existing recursive Object/Dynamic owners. Containers own cardinality, offsets/null maps/discriminators, dictionary lifetime, stream profile and prefix/body state. No serializer per Cartesian type product or new transpose algorithm.
implementation.initial_falsifier: Public WidePartWriter reached ObjectSharedCopyCodec, then encode_dynamic_bulk_child refused direct QBit; actual guarded runtime exit1 before production edits.

fixture.raw_sentinels: Little-endian signed zero and distinct NaN payloads, without decimal float conversion.
fixture.writer: WidePartWriter.write_uint64_object_pair; source documents decoded through public reader. Separate literal public spec and root oracle prevent stock/library differential agreement from being the sole oracle.

boundaries.rollback: Revert only the exact scoped atomic local W200 commit. No push or unrelated changes.
boundaries.strongest_failure: Self-roundtrip/CHECK succeeds while direct typed reads lose nominal type, raw payload, presence, PK or selected window; echoed profiles fail to prove physical shared placement.
guards: Exact persisted empty typed/Object-dynamic/Dynamic-structure rosters on both source/library sides.

source_spec_identity.command: ruby -rjson -rdigest -e 'files = Dir.glob("{src,spec}/**/*").select { |p| File.file?(p) && !File.symlink?(p) }.sort; digest = Digest::SHA256.new; files.each { |p| digest.update(p + "\0" + Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest + "\n") }; puts JSON.generate(files: files.size, sha256: digest.hexdigest)'

limitations: The temp reconciler reuses the pinned runner parser/SQL generator but authors fixture expectations and input parsing separately; root also hand-checks byte sentinels.

native_attach_metadata_falsifier.ordering_scope: Pinned-runtime observed byte order; source NameSet is unordered.

light_checks.standalone_packet_validator: Not available; JSON syntax and packet/source consistency are checked without claiming substantive validation by structure.

continuity.next: Remaining legal recursive physical wrapper/site contracts and JSON-as-Dynamic-actual, then full-types/MV/projection compatibility. Broad one-class-per-file decomposition remains open.
continuity.decay_trigger: Dependent codec/helper/runner/source revision, compiler/runtime/profile/guard change, or loss of temporary raw evidence.
continuity.refresh: Re-execute exact suites, fresh builds and separate native captures, then raw reconciliation/falsifiers; reopen dependent claims and keep unsupported guards on failure.
